stock.description: Operating as an investment holding company, CBK Holdings Limited's primary focus lies in providing culinary services, particularly through its network of hotpot dining establishments across Hong Kong. As of March 31, 2022, its operations also encompassed a Korean eatery, Aidan Cafe, situated in Tai Wai, alongside a distinct venue named Shio located in Central, Hong Kong. The firm additionally extends its offerings to include management advisory services. This enterprise was established in 2016 and maintains its corporate headquarters in Central, Hong Kong.
